content.short: GetBlock is a node service provider that offers blockchain-as-a-service and APIs to build.
content.description: GetBlock serves blockchain-dependent businesses by enabling them to run customized private nodes or access shared nodes as needed, providing a flexible foundation for diverse operational setups across multiple networks. The platform offers APIs to integrate crypto payments via DeFi services and custodial wallet functionality, simplifying payment flows, asset management, and secure transaction processing. With support across Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, BNB Chain, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, Solana, Multichain, and Aptos, the service adapts to varied deployment needs.
content.meta: GetBlock is a service provider for blockchain-reliant businesses to host custom private nodes or use shared nodes. Discover GetBlock and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
